run_dcgan_training: run the DCGAN training script with argparse to train a generator and discriminator on a dataset
create_generator_model: create a Keras Sequential generator model with Conv2DTranspose layers for image generation
create_discriminator_model: create a Keras Sequential discriminator model with Conv2D layers for image classification
preprocess_images_for_tf: preprocess a HuggingFace dataset by normalizing pixel values and converting to a TensorFlow dataset
generate_and_save_images: generate sample images from the trained generator model and save them as PNG files
